entries.name: Falling
entries.description: A creature takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage for every 10 feet it falls, to a maximum of 20d6, and lands prone unless it avoids the damage.

entries.name: Vision and Light
entries.description: Lightly and heavily obscured areas, bright light, dim light and darkness, and the senses that see through them: blindsight, darkvision and truesight.

entries.name: Surprise
entries.description: A creature that doesn't notice a threat at the start of an encounter is surprised: it can't move or take an action on its first turn, or take a reaction until that turn ends.
